concerns.description: Desired configuration, observed generations and application evidence
concerns.rationale: Intended configuration and observed device state are separate durable concepts with separate logical owners.

concerns.description: Fenced idempotent reconciliation under stale telemetry
concerns.rationale: Progress depends on stable intent, fair retries and reachable devices; neither monotonic convergence nor bounded completion is implied by a Process edge.

concerns.description: Route computation and device protocol adapters
concerns.rationale: A route solver implementation can change while topology/policy digests and feasibility meaning remain fixed.

concerns.description: Replicated coordinators with epoch-fenced device writes
concerns.rationale: Physical replicas implement one logical owner; epoch allocation/fencing is a concrete deployment obligation.

concerns.description: Adversarial epoch and retry validation handoff
concerns.rationale: The current state/trace sketch records validation obligations only; an executed temporal protocol model would be a separate C artifact, not a kernel extension.

facets.meaning: After intent stabilizes, repeated reconciliation should approach the same admitted configuration under explicitly stated availability assumptions.
obligations: Specify fair retry and observable success criteria.
Test stale epochs, reordered telemetry and duplicate receipts; no liveness or consensus proof is supplied.

facets.meaning: Slow devices must not create unbounded retry work.
obligations: Choose finite limits and retry budgets in the realization.
Prove coalescing does not discard required teardown operations before adopting it.

realization.strategy: Generation-aware reconciliation, idempotency keys and device-side epoch fencing; protocol adapters realize typed boundaries.
realization.placement: Coordinator replicas and routing workers may be distributed; a fencing authority and durable observations are explicit dependencies.
limitations: No consensus protocol or temporal proof is implemented.
Conditional convergence is not a bounded completion guarantee during partitions.

artifacts.claim: Unexecuted state and adversarial-trace handoff only; no formal model checker run.

sources.title: Ptolemy II models of computation
sources.supports: Directors define distinct continuous-time, discrete-event, synchronous/reactive and dataflow laws; typed graph edges alone do not supply them.

sources.title: AUTOSAR Classic Platform
sources.supports: Application, RTE and basic software separation illustrates logical contract versus platform realization; no AUTOSAR conformance claimed.

sources.title: Arcadia method
sources.supports: Logical architecture versus physical architecture supports keeping semantic ownership independent of processor placement.

sources.title: RFC 8342 Network Management Datastore Architecture
sources.supports: Intended and operational configuration can differ because of propagation, protocol and hardware state; intent is not an observation.
